description: Implementation of MojoAudioDecoderService class handling audio decoding via Mojo IPC, including initialization, decoding, resetting, and buffer management.

classes.name: MojoAudioDecoderService
classes.description: A service class that manages audio decoding through Mojo IPC, handling initialization, decoding, buffer reading, and client communication.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with a media log and client remote.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the decoder with a given configuration and optional CDM ID, handling encryption context.

methods.name: SetDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for decoding via a data pipe.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder and buffer reader.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Callback handler for decoder initialization result.

methods.name: OnReadDone
methods.description: Callback after reading a decoder buffer.

methods.name: OnReaderFlushDone
methods.description: Callback after flushing the buffer reader.

methods.name: OnAudioBufferReady
methods.description: Handles ready audio buffers and sends them to the client.

methods.name: OnWaiting
methods.description: Handles waiting reasons and notifies the client.
